description: This file defines a Symfony Console command class 'AddDataGroupCommand' that manages the creation of data groups and associated API permissions within the OrangeHRM system. It includes configuration, interaction, execution methods, and SQL logging for data insertion, tailored for internal project automation.

classes.name: AddDataGroupCommand
classes.description: A Symfony Console Command for adding DataGroups and related API Permissions within the OrangeHRM system, with interactive prompts and SQL output.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the command with description, arguments, and options.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the command with SymfonyStyle for interaction.

methods.name: interact
methods.description: Interactively prompts the user for data group details and API permission info if applicable.

methods.name: getModuleAutocompleteQuestion
methods.description: Creates a Question object with autocompletion for module names.

methods.name: notBlankValidation
methods.description: Validates that a given input string is not blank.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main execution method that creates DataGroup and optionally ApiPermission, outputs SQL samples and tables.

methods.name: printDataGroupTable
methods.description: Displays a table of the data group's properties.

methods.name: printDataGroupSQL
methods.description: Outputs sample SQL insert statements for the DataGroup.

methods.name: printApiPermissionTable
methods.description: Displays a table for API permission details.

methods.name: printApiPermissionSQL
methods.description: Outputs SQL statements to insert API permission data.

methods.name: printBlock
methods.description: Outputs a block message in yellow format.
